product_overview: CRM is a customer relationship management application for sales teams and account managers to track customers, deals, and activities. It provides dashboards, customer and deal management, and activity tracking in a responsive web interface.
core_goals: View a snapshot of customer, deal, and pipeline performance
Create and manage deals across sales stages
Review customer, deal, and activity details in list and detail views

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Show a summary of the sales workspace including customer counts, pipeline value, win rate, recent activity, and deal stage distribution.
user_flows: Navigate to the dashboard -> View total customers, open deals, pipeline value, and win rate cards -> Review the recent activities feed -> Review the deals by stage chart -> Use a quick action to start adding a customer, deal, or activity

features.name: Customers
features.description: Browse, search, filter, add, and bulk delete customer records.
user_flows: Navigate to the customers screen -> Search for customers by name, email, or company -> Filter customers by status -> Review the paginated customer table -> Select one or more customers -> Delete the selected customers
Navigate to the customers screen -> Start adding a customer -> Enter customer details -> Submit the form -> See the new customer appear in the list

features.name: Customer Detail
features.description: View a single customer’s information along with related deals and activities, and manage the customer record.
user_flows: Open a customer from the customers list -> View the customer information card -> Review related deals -> Review the activities timeline -> Start editing customer details -> Save changes -> See the updated customer information
Open a customer from the customers list -> Start deleting the customer -> Confirm the action -> Return to the customers list

features.name: Deals
features.description: Browse deals in a kanban board or table view, search and filter them, and create new deals linked to customers.
user_flows: Navigate to the deals screen -> Switch to the kanban board view -> Review deals grouped by stage -> Search for deals by customer, stage, or value -> Use the table view for a list-based review
Navigate to the deals screen -> Start adding a deal -> Choose a customer -> Enter deal details -> Submit the form -> See the new deal in the deal list
Navigate to the deals screen -> Start moving a deal to a new stage -> Review the updated stage placement on the board -> Continue tracking the deal in its new stage

features.name: Deal Detail
features.description: Inspect a deal’s details, update its probability, manage related activities, and move it through the sales pipeline.
user_flows: Open a deal from the deals list -> View the deal information -> Adjust the probability value -> Save the update -> See the revised deal details
Open a deal from the deals list -> Review related activities -> Move the deal to another stage -> See the updated stage reflected in the deal view
Open a deal from the deals list -> Start deleting the deal -> Confirm the action -> Return to the deals list

features.name: Activities
features.description: Track sales activities in a timeline and manage completion status for each activity.
user_flows: Navigate to the activities screen -> Filter activities by type, customer, or deal -> Review the activity timeline -> Mark an activity complete -> See the completion status update

Navigate to the activities screen -> Start adding an activity -> Choose the activity type -> Enter the description -> Optionally set a scheduled time -> Submit the form -> See the new activity in the timeline

routes.description: Dashboard with stats, upcoming bookings, floors and team presence
Browse and book available desks by floor and date
Browse and book available meeting rooms
View, check-in and cancel own desk and room bookings
List all floors in the workspace
Floor plan view with desk occupancy
Admin panel for managing users, floors, desks and rooms

features.name: User Login
user_interactions: See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new workspace and admin account

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: View workspace stats, upcoming bookings and floor occupancy
user_interactions: View upcoming desk and room bookings count
View desk bookings for last 7 days
View floors list with links to floor plans

features.name: Desk Booking
features.description: Browse available desks by floor/date and book one
user_interactions: Enter colleague email for neighborhood desks
Click Book on an available desk
Join waiting list for unavailable desk
See success or error message after booking

features.name: Room Booking
features.description: Browse and book available meeting rooms
user_interactions: Enter meeting title for a room
Click Book on an available room

features.name: My Bookings
features.description: View, check-in and cancel personal desk and room bookings
user_interactions: Toggle between upcoming and all bookings
Check in to a confirmed desk booking
View QR code for desk booking

features.name: Floor Plan View
features.description: Visual floor plan showing desk positions and occupancy
user_interactions: View floor plan with desk grid
Click desk to view details or book

features.name: Analytics
features.description: Workspace utilization and ESG sustainability reports

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Admin management of users, floors, desks and rooms

known_limitations.issue: Authentication token stored in localStorage, not httpOnly cookie
known_limitations.impact: Token accessible via JS, potential XSS risk

known_limitations.issue: Floor plan is a grid layout, not a true SVG floor map
known_limitations.impact: Limited visual accuracy for complex floor layouts
